prompt:
A desktop marketing landing page for White Sail Labs, an independent market research lab, rendered edge to edge at 1440 by 900 with crisp readable text, no browser window, device or desk around it.

The visitor is an investor, CEO or strategist deciding whether to request early access. White Sail Labs sells research as a subscription: applied AI engineers and business engineers build an always-on fleet of agents that keeps a living model of every company, and each new fact's surprise travels along the value chain to suppliers and customers.

The page IS a synoptic pressure chart of the economy, filling the viewport edge to edge, fine isobar lines sweeping behind everything. A deep navy band across the top carries a cream sail silhouette with three short speed lines beside the wordmark White Sail Labs, and the navigation Who we are, Capabilities, Careers, Contact, Request early access.

What leads is a plain, unmistakable cause-and-effect diagram drawn on the chart, reading left to right across the upper middle of the page: three large weather-station plots in a row, each a circle with a crisp label underneath. Left: "NVIDIA · Cause · Q3 revenue $57.0B vs model $54.1B · surprise +$2.9B". A thick weather front with blue triangles runs from NVIDIA and ends in a clear arrowhead at the middle station: "TSMC · Supplier · revenue forecast +1.8%". A second thick front with red semicircles runs from NVIDIA and ends in a clear arrowhead at the right station: "Microsoft · Customer · capex forecast +2.4%". A small tag reads Illustrative. A few other stations sit faint in the background.

The chart's title block, a ruled rectangle inset in the lower left corner, holds the headline "Your decisions. Better informed." set very large, the line "A research lab of people and agents, not an AI tool.", and the actions Request early access and Get in touch. The bottom margin reads "Issued 11 Nov 09:42 · Next update: continuous".

Visual law: a met office chart's crisp off-white ground with fine black isobar linework, cold-front blue and warm-front red as the only colours besides the navy band, station plots and front symbols as the signature, labels in a clear technical grotesk. One dominant move: the cause-and-effect chain.
note: Second render; the first used the pick comp as a reference and lost the direct chain.
